concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 (download & parse datasets) has no task explicitly linked via a [FR-001] tag or description; implementers lack a concrete work item to satisfy this requirement.
Functional Requirement FR-002 (structural metric extraction with fallback) is not referenced by any task; no task ensures the fallback logic is implemented or validated.
Functional Requirement FR-003 (full‑environment baseline execution) lacks a dedicated task tag; while T009 and T013 perform baseline work, they are not linked to FR-003, leaving traceability unclear.
Functional Requirement FR-004 (train predictive model) is not explicitly covered by a task tag; T023, T024, T028, T028a implement modeling but do not reference FR-004.
Functional Requirement FR-005 (sensitivity analysis & safety threshold) is not directly tied to any task; T028a performs a success‑criteria test but does not cite FR-005.
Functional Requirement FR-006 (associational framing) is not linked to a task; the causal/associational filter scripts (T044a, T044b) exist but lack an FR‑006 tag.
Success Criterion SC-001 (measure false‑negative rate) is not associated with any task; no test or verification step explicitly checks this metric.
Success Criterion SC-002 (measure reduction in dynamic‑execution cycles) has no corresponding task; the pipeline does not include a test that computes or reports this percentage.
Success Criterion SC-003 (measure correlation coefficient) is not covered by any task; while model_report.json includes a correlation field, no test validates its correctness or presence.
